P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for text readability treatments.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockups (phone/laptop/book) are shown in the layout.

N08.rationale: There is a significant amount of sparse dead whitespace at the bottom of the page below the main content block.
